No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this visit you connect local archaeological evidence with regional timelines.

The gallery, date, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Museum introduction
  • Chronology-driven gallery selection
  • Material and sculpture comparison
  • Short object analysis worksheet

How the time is spent

  1. Museum introduction 25 min

  2. Chronology-driven gallery selection 35 min

  3. Material and sculpture comparison 50 min

  4. Short object analysis worksheet 30 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Place local archaeological evidence in regional timelines through a chronology-led selection of galleries.
  • Compare materials and sculpture across the periods shown in the museum.
  • Record a short analysis of a single object using a worksheet.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
